item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i bka' srung dam can gza' bdud chen po'i bskul pa
item.coloph: ces pa'i rig 'dzin chen po'i bka' nyan dregs pa pho nya gza' bdud nag po'i bskul pa dgra srog gcod pa'i ral gri zhes bya ba 'di yang / bon sgo 'di la mos shing brtson pa'i rigs mthun gyi snying grogs rnams kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ gsang 'dus tshe dbang gis byin rlabs spral pa'i rol gar kho bo bde chen snying po'am lung zin gsang mtshan g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ dbyon (dben) gnas ke'u tshang nyi 'od phug tu srid gsum rgyal mo lha bza' mtshan drug bsnyen pa'i thun mtshams su/ pho nya rgyu ba'i tshes la dge bar spel lo/ dge des bstan pa'i spyi dgra ming med du brlag pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
